mathematical_meanings: Left image: A names the set represented by the circle (the label under the left circle containing 9 and 11 in its exclusive region). Right image: A names an element of the output set of the mapping (the top element in the f(x) oval receiving arrows from 1 and 4).
Rationales: On the left, A names the set represented by the circle (the label under the left circle containing 9 and 11 in its exclusive region). On the right, A names an element of the output set of the mapping (the top element in the f(x) oval receiving arrows from 1 and 4).
